credit.credit-words: I Heard the Bells on Christmas Day
WORDS: Henry W. Longfellow, 1864; alt. and v. 5-7 by Harlan D. Sorrell. MUSIC: “Waltham”; John B. Calkin, 1872. Public Domain.
There was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying, Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men. Lk. 2:13-14; Rom. 5:1
